name: KUG 0203-Dw1 (Hubble)
blurb: KUG 0203-Dw1, an ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kug203dw1-hubble
story: A faint, diffuse dwarf galaxy just southwest of the galaxy KUG 0203-100, trailing a tidal plume, with a stellar stream lying between the two: signs of a gravitational tug-of-war with its larger neighbor.

claims.text: KUG 0203-Dw1 is an ultra-diffuse galaxy with tidal features
A stellar stream lies between KUG 0203-Dw1 and KUG 0203-100
Hubble target KUG203-DW1 is one of the program's ultra-diffuse galaxies in a group
The paper used Hubble ACS imaging
